title: 类目明细销售额
query: 只查询 ecommerce_ops：统计2026年8月1日至22日下单且订单实付金额大于0的订单，按商品类目名称汇总订单明细实付金额，取金额最高的10类。
reason: 结果数值和维度匹配（忽略别名、列顺序、行顺序）

result.sql: WITH filtered_orders AS (SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23 00:00:00' AND paid_amount > 0) SELECT pc.category_name AS "商品类目名称", SUM(oi.paid_amount) AS "订单明细实付金额" FROM filtered_orders fo JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = fo.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN product_categories pc ON pc.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY pc.category_name ORDER BY SUM(oi.paid_amount) DESC LIMIT 10
